author_doubts_decisions: The loan exchange is accepted. A request to borrow precedes Ik geef je mijn potlood and an explicit return instruction follows it, so no gift-versus-loan distinction determines a key.

En in de pauze? is a natural short follow-up about lesson activities after the teacher mentions before/after class. Hier in de gang? directly follows Waar moet ik staan? and is immediately corrected. Neither requires a hidden premise to answer a question.

Lenen, tekenen, potlood, gum, terug, rugzak and pas name familiar activities or concrete objects. The short context makes their roles explicit. Retain them as authoring-target vocabulary; learner difficulty still needs evidence.
Replace geld with munten. Money also covers a card balance, so the original payment distractor could overlap the key. Coins remove that overlap and remain directly anchored.
A teacher and a shop seller were labelled only by role. Personal names Mark and Ruben meet the literal two-named-speaker rule. Speaker roles, spoken words and question references stay consistent.
